title: OTE Shell Test Manifest
description: Defines shell-based tests for OpenShift Tests Extension (OTE)

defaults.description: Default values applied to all tests unless overridden

labels.description: Labels applied to every test (e.g., SMOKE, SLOW)

tags.description: Key-value tags applied to every test

lifecycle.description: Default lifecycle: blocking (failures are fatal) or informing (failures are logged)

timeout.description: Default timeout as a Go duration (e.g., 5m, 30s, 1h)

env.description: Environment variables injected into every test (per-test overrides on collision)

cluster_profile.description: Default cluster profile for step registry integration (e.g., aws, gcp, azure)

name.description: Full OTE test name. Convention: [sig-xxx] descriptive name

script.description: Path to the shell script, relative to the manifest file

labels.description: Labels for this test (merged with defaults)

tags.description: Key-value tags (merged with defaults, per-test overrides)

lifecycle.description: Override the default lifecycle for this test

timeout.description: Override the default timeout for this test

include.description: CEL expression — test only runs when this evaluates to true against the cluster environment

exclude.description: CEL expression — test is skipped when this evaluates to true against the cluster environment

env.description: Environment variables injected into this test (merged with defaults, per-test wins)

from_image.description: Container image to pull test dependencies from (step registry metadata)

credentials.description: Credential mounts required by this test (step registry metadata)

mount_path.description: Mount path in the test container

cluster_profile.description: Cluster profile for step registry integration (e.g., aws, gcp, azure)

suites.description: Suite definitions (optional — defaults are generated if omitted)

qualifiers.description: CEL expressions OR'd together for test selection

parents.description: Parent suites this suite participates in
